question: Which model achieves the lowest CoLeG-R score across all SFT configurations?
reviewer_notes: Initial question now wrong but having two alternate but close answers dilutes its effectiveness as admittance test.
model_answer: LLaMA-2-70B achieves the lowest CoLeG-R score across all SFT configurations. Specifically, it reaches a score of approximately 65% when no SFT is applied. This is lower than any score achieved by LLaMA-2-13B, regardless of SFT application.
